newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BT Intnl sues over Rural Property Trust.
newsitem.headline: BT Intnl sues over Rural Property Trust.

text.p: London-based Bankers Trust International Plc said it filed proceedings in the Federal Court of Australia on Thursday against Rural and Agricultural Management Ltd (RAM), the manager of Rural Property Trust (RPT).

BTI, which holds 19.9 percent of RPT, said it alleged in its proceedings that RAM engaged in misleading and deceptive conduct in relation to documents distributed for a meeting of RPT unitholders set for June 3.
In March, BTI said it had requisitioned an extraordinary meeting of unitholders to remove RAM as RPT's manager because of what it said was a poor profitability record.
RAM then defended its record and said it would propose the corporatisation of the group. The June 3 meeting was called to approve the plan.

In Thursday's statement, BTI said RAM's information memorandum for unitholders contained a number of statements which it believed were likely to mislead unitholders and it had decided to commence legal action.
BTI said it supported corporatisation of RPT but added that it believed RAM's corporatisation proposal would continue RAM's control both of the trust and the new company.
